1143.title: Route 4 Detour: Cary Senior Center Voting Site, Oct 16 (starting 1 p.m.) – Oct 31, and Nov 3, 2026
1143.body:
Route 4 Detour: Cary Senior Center Voting Site
Oct 16 (starting 1 p.m.) – Oct 31, and Nov 3, 2026
Due to early voting and Election Day at the Cary Senior Center, expect increased traffic and possible delays on Route 4.
Closed stops:
Bond Park at Cary Senior Center (Stop ID 11022)
Maury O’Dell Place at Bond Park Community Center (Stop ID 11391)
Plan extra travel time. Questions? Call GoCary at (919) 485-RIDE (7433).
